purpose: Detect Prompt Kit execution failures in third-party agent hosts without collecting user code, repository identity, transcript content, reasoning text, shell arguments, error strings, account identity, or stable device identity.
privacy_invariants: Third-party hook payloads are toxic input; only explicitly enumerated categorical fields may cross the host-adapter boundary.
Contribution capsules are constructed from an empty allowlist schema, never by redacting a full host payload.
Prompt/response/reasoning/error/command/path/workspace/repository/email/session/device/account identity and exact timestamps are forbidden from capsules.
The prototype contains no network sender.
Local-only observability must remain useful when networking is permanently disabled.
Hard-stop detection belongs outside the acting agent; finalization receipts improve precision but are never the sole detector.
Public prompt provenance is limited to a bounded prompt id and public release bucket.
Repository learning is a future projection over approved aggregate phenotypes, never raw individual forensic evidence.

deployment_operating_model.rationale: A local hook process plus zero-content state is sufficient for detection/explanation; remote infrastructure is unnecessary for P0.
deployment_operating_model.successor_networking_gate: Evaluate anonymous contribution only after local privacy canaries pass and a separate privacy/consent contract is approved.

domain_vocabulary.HostHookPayload: Raw third-party hook JSON; toxic by default and never durable.
domain_vocabulary.HostSignal: Small allowlisted categorical event emitted by a host adapter.
domain_vocabulary.PromptProvenance: Public prompt id plus bounded public release bucket.
domain_vocabulary.RunState: Local zero-content state owned by the sentinel.
domain_vocabulary.FailurePhenotype: Canonical host-independent explanation of execution failure.
domain_vocabulary.ContributionCapsule: Fixed-schema local preview containing no user content or stable user identity.

modules.owns: Raw Cursor payload -> HostSignal translation only.
modules.failure_contract: Reject unsupported/content-bearing hooks and unbounded provenance.
Fail closed on malformed state; never write raw payloads.

modules.owns: Run lifecycle, receipt reconciliation, failure phenotype selection.
modules.failure_contract: Unknown material stop becomes fail-safe boundary rather than silent success.

candidate_comparison.reason: Starts with toxic data and depends on perfect removal.
Silent cessation can prevent the receipt.
External liveness plus explicit terminal proof without content dependence.

phase_map.gate: Focused tests plus deterministic floor; no network transport.
Observed local Cursor runs for success, semantic abandonment, user abort, and host error.
Explicit opt-in, unlinkability analysis, thresholding/privacy budget, and no-content wire proof.
Repository consumes only approved aggregate phenotypes.

proof_ceiling: P0 proves local adapter/sentinel/compiler behavior and forbidden-data non-reachability under deterministic fixtures. It does not prove Cursor installation, arbitrary hostile runtimes, anonymous transport, differential privacy, or repository aggregation.
